test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Jatin said, "I was at home yesterday."

options.text: Jatin said he was at home the day before.
Jatin said he was at home.
Jatin said that he had been at home the day before.
Jatin said that he was at home yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Jatin said that he had been at home the day before.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I was at home yesterday" becomes "that he had been at home the day before"**
 
 
• The pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the reporting subject.
 
• The verb "was" is changed to "had been" to reflect the past perfect tense.
 
• The time expression "yesterday" is converted to "the day before".
 
 
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:** 
 
 
• Direct: "said"
 
• Indirect: "said that"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jatin said that he had been at home the day before."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Jatin said he was at home the day before." 

 
 
• Tense is not correctly converted to past perfect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Jatin said he was at home." 
 
 
• Does not specify the time reference "yesterday".
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Jatin said that he was at home yesterday." 
 
 
• Does not convert the time expression "yesterday" to "the day before".
